subject: 赌场
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Image edit of the construction reference: turn the beige plane into a realistic thin stone floor and place a Southern Song Chinese gaming-house on it. LOCK the floor polygon's four corners and angles exactly as provided; each geometric grid square is one metre. Footprint 10 metres along the long lower-left frontage and 8 metres along the shorter lower-right side. Draw a modest TWO-storey timber hall with grey clay tile roof, creamy plaster sidewall, open lower-left doorway and lattice balcony; a plain wooden gaming table and stools are visible inside the veranda. This is ancient China year 1223, unpretentious but prosperous, realistic game environment detail, warm natural timber and muted neutral stone palette. Exact 2:1 orthographic projection, matching the guide axes ±0.500, pillars vertical, no perspective. KEEP the plane corners (150,850), (694,1122), (1130,904), (586,632) in the square frame. Do not move or rotate the floor. Naturally textured floor without drawn grid, no outline. Replace white with true transparent alpha. Left-upper lighting, right-lower contact shadow. Full roof and floor uncut, at least 8% transparent margin. No text, symbol, signs, humans, background, shadow halo, modern gambling, neon, checkerboard, decorative diagram. Geometry and correct width-depth relation take precedence over decorative details.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: geometry-only construction guide; no asset pixels drawn by code
